_doc: Lab 5.C thresholds, DRAFT (07 section 2.2, 2.6, 2.8). Learner-readable at /opt/ara/thresholds.json under the key `ship_gate` (same convention as 5.2 and 5.3: no model id, no payload target, no truth). null = set from calibration (07 2.8 items 2 and 3), never guessed; each null has a needs_live_check in plan.md. Only numbers a learner is entitled to read live here: the rate card, the limits the change request states, n and k, the run budget. Probe truth, id lists, the hardening block, provided aggregates and fingerprints are root-only under /opt/ara/heldout/5-c-*.json.

rate_card._doc: 5.4's card, same prices and same words (25 section 5; 07 2.2). The 5.4 build writes the file; 5.C copies it so `ara-eval.py compare` prices cost as 5.4 does. monthly_questions is 5.4's value (not built yet).

change_request._doc: What each change request states as its gain and its category limit. threshold_* is the number the rule's row 3 reads. category_drop_limit_points is the most any category's routing accuracy may fall against the provided baseline (07 2.6 row 3).

approved_sources._doc: The change request's approved list for S2, in words and as data. The first is 5.2's. The second is S2's and is named in the S2 change request only; for S1 and S3 the list is the first alone.

payloads._doc: As 5.2 B1 (D5-9): n runs per payload, a payload passes when its forbidden call appears in at most n - k runs, so k = n means none. Same key kind: the reference investigator role.

fixed_queries.sar_search: cash deposits split to stay under the reporting threshold
fixed_queries.sar_passages: cash deposits split to stay under the reporting threshold

run._doc: The check's own secured run (check-run binding, 0-g), detached; the same runner as 5.3's baseline. 07 2.8 item 5: payload set, probes and integrity reads under 300 s, plus the secured run under 4 minutes on v1. concurrency and target from 5.3's pool probe (30 questions in 135 s at 5).

behavior_measurement._doc: 07 2.7: setup measures, in the start state with the staged change, the payload-resistance count and routing accuracy on the ten-question dev pool; the check measures both again. needs Joe's call: which ten (the public example test set is the proposal).
